notes.title: IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
Dear Crania Games followers, 
We are sorry to inform you that, our next title, A Way to be Dead 's release date has been postponed. 

Being a small independent studio, we have limited possibilities with internal testing. And with the desire to deliver our game to it's full potential for our whole player base to enjoy, we have decided to widen our release window to iron out any bugs and improve the game generally.

With this extra time before release, we will be running a closed beta that anyone can apply to and help us make the game better. Please stay tuned for the closed beta announcement, which will contain all the application details along with the application form.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your understanding and patience!

Crania Games

notes.title: Roots of Insanity Update v0.02 (17th of May 2017)
notes.content:
Greetings,

It's been a while since you heard from us. We were working about our second huge update for almost a month and we believe we finally managed to finish it. This update, we mainly changed gameplay and more importantly, the combat system.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/9619b29438ddf6ba6324fa86c0c8ad1c96a472bd.png[/img]

[b][u]Update v0.02[/u][/b]

[*] Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese and Russian languages have been fixed and they have been checked by native speakers.

[*] New weapon added (Axe). If you aim a zombie's head with it, you can chop their head off.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/26b0881e99fea29d655da1cc724e61465c0dfce1.jpg[/img] 

[*] Butter knife has been changed to the butcher knife. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/94936236d589c54fe94682ca5d75a8a55ee1748f.jpg[/img]

[*] Weapons' damage have been balanced.

[*] Health and Energy bars, along with some new visual aspects, have been added to the interface

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/47ef392e6e86b17164348dae8aebf2266c14f4e5.jpg[/img]

[*] Environment has been reorganized and new objects have been added.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/64786ea6bc96083a87a2290a683e8d5fd2c3e4d6.jpg[/img]

[*] Added inspection mechanic.

[*] New inspectable objects have been added. You will be able to take some of them. They will provide health, energy, or battery, depending on the item.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/93fa51b24335beef2c2f5d8fa7c0d4c49ddf31b1.jpg[/img]

[*] Added new puzzle to Unknown Forest level

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/d9e1af1304f54112d2cd420451d54f4b0666cbc2.jpg[/img]

[*] Jump mechanic has been added.

[*] Fridges have better loot mechanic now. If you do not find any medicine two times in a row, third fridge will have one for sure.

[*] Subtitles and widgets can be disable now.[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/4ba152d420998b980cba0b6b641f2529ac88587e.jpg[/img]

Roots of Insanity is now more exciting and horrifying than ever. So, what are you waiting for?
ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Guideline, Known Issues and Workarounds
notes.content:
Greetings,

As you know, Roots of Insanity has been released recently. We would like to say we are aware of the issues, bugs and glitches. Unfortunately; we are small indie development team that tries to take care of everything. So we expect to you to be little bit more patient. Thanks for your understanding.

[u][b]Here is a Guideline for you to help finishing Roots of Insanity:[/b][/u]

- On the top of CHAIRS you can find  batteries, medicines and ammo and it DOESN'T have random loot mechanics. It means that you should keep eye on chairs most of the time. We believe we put enough loots on to them.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/5810fbc7ed2ffa2e2d88712b30a52e4175a76835.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/fa68ea301251c6ec21f97f4e2b195f087abc357d.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/6ce6082cb2991e49edf50337b1dbcaf8e838b81d.jpg[/img]

[b]Random Loot Objects:[/b]

- LOCKERS includes ONLY batteries and they have random loot mechanics. It means that when you open one locker and if it has no battery, it can be possible after you died or reloaded the last checkpoint changes the situation. (Same possibility valid  for the opposite.)

- FRIDGES and MEDICINE BOX  includes ONLY medicines and they have random loot mechanics as well. It means that you can adapt what we say in first thick

- NOTES have a big role for finishing Roots of Insanity. Some of them even triggers some doors open so it means that if you cant get out of somewhere or some room, its possibility that you should simply find the note around there.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/599bf8e5522a2660ad6cfd9ccd3371c2a1ec4578.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/ac89e3b6c271f98ea69440d8742fbc6a8574713a.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/2ad90fd57196420866bb87d2eff0a7132aea24d3.jpg[/img]

[b]Another useful Tips[/b]

-  THE MORE SEARCH, MORE LOOT. More loot means finishing Roots of Insanity easier.

- Its recommended that never use all your bullets for one scene. You can kill it only zombies who run, then you can simply kill others with your amazing knife :). Bullets might be helpful for the next stages...

[u][b]Known issues:[/b][/u]

- Game has some problems with Windows 8.1.

- Some achievements bugged and doesn't work.

- TPS mode camera issues.

- Crawler zombie throws other zombies.

We are working so hard to make Roots of Insanity more enjoyable. As I said on the top, we are thankful for your patience. 

This is our support mail: support@craniagames.com
You can reach directly our developers with this e-mail.

notes.title: Roots of Insanity has been released!!!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Ladies and Gentleman,[/b]

Are you ready to try a horror game that will leave you asking for more? With a story that pulls you in, fluid gameplay and a hospital full of mysteries... Roots of Insanity invites you to a riveting experience. Come and explore this amazing story with Dr Riley McClein.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/13a11830529e5c0b3faa827ac28ddceae06edeff.png[/img]

[b]Description[/b]

You are Riley McClein, a doctor who has to deal with his epileptic attacks while trying to survive in the eerie environment of the August Valentine Hospital. It was supposed to be an ordinary night shift for you. Even your epileptic attacks have been relatively manageable, as long as you took your medicine regularly. A woman’s scream pierces the quiet night at the hospital. You immediately have a minor attack and decide to get out of your office to get more medicine and find the source of that scream. The moment you step out of your office, you find yourself entangled in a mess you cannot get out of. As Dr. Riley McClein, you need to help the other people in the hospital, but you also have to manage your own epileptic attacks. You have to to uncover what is going on at the hospital, but can you do so while dealing with your own condition and the things out there that you never expected to see?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/722ef5f92c7861ccb5b7b1b123d69f288f5cffa7.png[/img]

[b]Features[/b]

- Combat system lets you hack, slash, kick and shoot as you fight for your life.
- Unique story line with many unexpected twists and turns.
- Optional areas to be discovered and explored.
- Random loot system.

[b]System Requirements[/b]

[u]Minimum:[/u]

OS: Windows 7 - 64 bits
Processor: Intel Core i3-5020U 1.80 GHz, AMD Opteron 3260 HE 2.7 GHz
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 285, AMD Radeon HD 5850
DirectX: Version 11.0 +
Storage: 4.6 GB available space
Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

[u]Recommended:[/u]

OS: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 - 64 bits
Processor: Intel Core i5-3570K 3.40GHz, ​AMD Opteron 6238​ 2.60 GHz
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 960, AMD Radeon R9 380
DirectX: Version 11.0 +
Storage: 4.6 GB available space
Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

Good Luck!
